title: Graded-module sheaf on Proj: Extension
statement: Let $S$ be an $\mathbb N$-graded commutative ring with grading $\mathcal A$, and $M$ a $\mathbb Z$-graded $S$-module with internal grading $\mathcal M$ compatible with scalar multiplication. Set $X=\operatorname{Proj}(S)$ [def-nagata-affine-proj]. Index charts by pairs $f=(a,d)$ with $d>0$ and $a\in S_d$, put $D_f=D_+(a)$, $R_f=S_{(a)}$ [def-nagata-homogeneous-localization-degree-zero], and let $Z_f$ be submodules of $M_a$ whose carriers are precisely the equal-degree fractions [def-sc-degree-zero-module-fractions]. Suppose additive maps $\rho_{f,g}:Z_f\to Z_g$ and ring maps $\rho^S_{f,g}:R_f\to R_g$ are given for every $D_g\subseteq D_f$. Suppose each inclusion admits a homogeneous relation $g^e=bf$ with $e>0$, each $\rho$ is semilinear over $\rho^S$, and for every such relation it sends $y/f^m$ to $b^my/g^{em}$. Assume identities, composition and bijectivity when chart opens coincide. Assume moreover every ring restriction is induced by a ring map $S_f\to S_g$ commuting with $S$. Then there is a quasi-coherent sheaf $F$ of $\mathcal O_X$-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category, pqf-def-coherent] with additive chart identifications $\alpha_f:F(D_f)\cong Z_f$, scalar compatible via awayToSection and restriction compatible via $\rho$. The ring maps agree with structure-sheaf restrictions. Any other sheaf with such chart identifications admits a unique compatible isomorphism from $F$.

proof.text: Ring restriction compatibility: compare the maps at every point using awayToSection_apply. The two ambient localization maps agree on S, so IsLocalization.ringHom_ext identifies them. Pointwise injectivity of homogeneous localization and Subtype.ext give equality of sections.

Transport each Z_f along the inverse of basicOpenIsoAway to a module over structure-sheaf sections. Ring restriction compatibility and the supplied semilinearity give rsmul. Use standardOpenProperties for the basis and finite refinement; multiplication defines the intersection index. Apply finite chart gluing and indexed basis extension to obtain F, linear equivalences iota, and its morphism universal property.

Take alpha to be the additive part of iota. Its scalar law is map_smul after canceling the ring equivalence. Given beta on G, beta inverse is linear for the transported scalar action and compatible with restriction. Apply the morphism universal property to beta inverse, use its bijectivity to get IsIso, and translate the component formulas through beta. Injectivity of beta translates uniqueness of the underlying morphism into the displayed unique compatible isomorphism.
Apply the chart quasi-coherence theorem to F, alpha, the proved scalar law and restriction compatibility.

theorem gradedModuleSheaf_extension
    (𝓜 : ℤ → AddSubgroup M) (h𝓜 : DirectSum.IsInternal 𝓜)
    (hsmul : ∀ (n : ℕ) (z : ℤ) (a : S) (y : M),
      a ∈ 𝒜 n → y ∈ 𝓜 z → a • y ∈ 𝓜 (n + z))
    (Z : ∀ f : Fidx, Submodule R[f] N[f])
    (hZ : (∀ f : Fidx, (Z f : Set N[f]) = degreeZeroFractions
        (fun n : ℕ ↦ (𝒜 n : Set S)) (fun n : ℕ ↦ (𝓜 n : Set M))
        (Submonoid.powers f.val.1)))
    (rhoS : ∀ (f g : Fidx), D[g] ≤ D[f] → R[f] →+* R[g])
    (rho : ∀ (f g : Fidx), D[g] ≤ D[f] → Z f →+ Z g)
    (hlaws : (∀ (f g : Fidx) (i : D[g] ≤ D[f]),
        (∃ (e k : ℕ) (a : S), 0 < e ∧ a ∈ 𝒜 k ∧ g.val.1 ^ e = a * f.val.1) ∧
        (∀ (r : R[f]) (q : Z f), rho f g i (r • q) = rhoS f g i r • rho f g i q) ∧
        (∀ (e k : ℕ) (a : S), 0 < e → a ∈ 𝒜 k → g.val.1 ^ e = a * f.val.1 →
          ∀ (m : ℕ) (y : M) (q : Z f),
            (q : N[f]) = mk y (⟨f.val.1 ^ m, ⟨m, rfl⟩⟩ : Submonoid.powers f.val.1) →
            (rho f g i q : N[g]) = mk (a ^ m • y)
              (⟨g.val.1 ^ (e * m), ⟨e * m, rfl⟩⟩ : Submonoid.powers g.val.1))) ∧
      (∀ (f : Fidx) (i : D[f] ≤ D[f]) (q : Z f), rho f f i q = q) ∧
      (∀ (f g h : Fidx) (i : D[g] ≤ D[f]) (j : D[h] ≤ D[g]) (q : Z f),
        rho g h j (rho f g i q) = rho f h (j.trans i) q) ∧
      (∀ (f g : Fidx) (i : D[g] ≤ D[f]), D[f] = D[g] →
        Function.Bijective (rho f g i)))
    (hcanonical : ∀ (f g : Fidx) (i : D[g] ≤ D[f]),
      ∃ l : Localization.Away f.val.1 →+* Localization.Away g.val.1,
        (∀ a : S, l (algebraMap S (Localization.Away f.val.1) a) =
          algebraMap S (Localization.Away g.val.1) a) ∧
        ∀ r : R[f], (rhoS f g i r).val = l r.val) :
    ∃ (F : ModX) (alpha : ∀ f : Fidx, F.val.obj (op D[f]) ≃+ Z f),
      (∀ (f : Fidx) (r : R[f]) (s : F.val.obj (op D[f])),
        alpha f ((awayToSection 𝒜 f.val.1 r) • s) = r • alpha f s) ∧
      (∀ (f g : Fidx) (i : D[g] ≤ D[f]) (s : F.val.obj (op D[f])),
        alpha g (F.val.map (homOfLE i).op s) = rho f g i (alpha f s)) ∧
      (∀ (f g : Fidx) (i : D[g] ≤ D[f]) (r : R[f]),
        (Proj 𝒜).presheaf.map (homOfLE i).op (awayToSection 𝒜 f.val.1 r) =
          awayToSection 𝒜 g.val.1 (rhoS f g i r)) ∧
      (∀ (G : ModX) (beta : ∀ f : Fidx, G.val.obj (op D[f]) ≃+ Z f),
        (∀ (f : Fidx) (r : R[f]) (s : G.val.obj (op D[f])),
          beta f ((awayToSection 𝒜 f.val.1 r) • s) = r • beta f s) →
        (∀ (f g : Fidx) (i : D[g] ≤ D[f]) (s : G.val.obj (op D[f])),
          beta g (G.val.map (homOfLE i).op s) = rho f g i (beta f s)) →
        ∃! phi : F ⟶ G, IsIso phi ∧
          ∀ (f : Fidx) (s : F.val.obj (op D[f])),
            beta f (phi.val.app (op D[f]) s) = alpha f s) ∧
      F.IsQuasicoherent
